name: @navbook/plugin-poll
description: Polls on issues: questions with options, a ballot per person, and the decision they come to

queryKeys.help: poll:STATE                   has a poll that is open or closed, or none for no poll (repeatable, ORs)
poll-awaiting:EMAIL           has an open poll waiting on EMAIL: they filed, hold or commented on the issue and have no counting vote (repeatable, ORs)

doctorChecks.description: the layout of every issue's poll/, and the schema of every poll and vote
a vote cast after its poll was closed, which is not counted, or stamped more than five minutes ahead of the clock
a poll or vote ID that is also another's, an entity's or a comment's

commands.name: poll
commands.description: ask the people on an issue to choose, and record what they decided

commands.name: open
commands.description: open a poll on an issue

arguments.name: issue
arguments.description: the issue's ID, or an unambiguous prefix of it

options.description: the poll, shaped like poll.md: YAML title and questions, then a Markdown preamble ('-' reads stdin); without it $EDITOR is opened on a template
the poll's title, in place of the one the file or the template has
wrap the change in a 'docs(poll):' commit

commands.name: vote
commands.description: vote on a poll; your new ballot replaces your last

arguments.name: poll
arguments.description: the poll's ID, or an unambiguous prefix of it

options.description: QUESTION=OPTION[,OPTION…], by ID or by number from 1; replaces that question's picks
QUESTION=TEXT: an answer in your own words, where the question accepts one
leave a question unanswered
start from an empty ballot rather than from your last one
why you voted as you did; replaces the note of your last ballot
take your vote back: a ballot that answers nothing
ask about each question even without a terminal, reading answers from stdin
wrap the change in a 'docs(poll):' commit

commands.name: show
commands.description: render a poll: its questions, where you stand, and the results when they are shown

arguments.name: poll
arguments.description: the poll's ID, or an unambiguous prefix of it

options.description: show the results even where the poll hides them until you vote
emit a single JSON object, results included

commands.name: list
commands.description: list polls; by default the open ones waiting on you

options.description: every poll, not only those waiting on you
only polls that are open or closed
only the polls on this issue
one JSON object per poll, newline-delimited

commands.name: edit
commands.description: change an open poll; a change to its questions revokes every vote

arguments.name: poll
arguments.description: the poll's ID, or an unambiguous prefix of it

options.description: the poll's new version, shaped like poll.md ('-' reads stdin); without it $EDITOR is opened on poll.md
wrap the change in a 'docs(poll):' commit

commands.name: close
commands.description: close a poll, recording what each question came to

arguments.name: poll
arguments.description: the poll's ID, or an unambiguous prefix of it

options.description: QUESTION=OPTION[,OPTION…] in place of what the votes came to; QUESTION= leaves it undecided
QUESTION=TEXT: decide on an answer given in other words
why, in Markdown
wrap the change in a 'docs(poll):' commit

commands.name: reopen
commands.description: reopen a closed poll; its decision is cleared and voting resumes

arguments.name: poll
arguments.description: the poll's ID, or an unambiguous prefix of it

options.description: wrap the change in a 'docs(poll):' commit
